C1714.title: FTC and Florida Sue Chargebacks911 for Obstructing Consumer Dispute Resolution
C1714.summary: The U.S. Federal Trade Commission (FTC) and the Florida Attorney General filed a lawsuit against Chargebacks911, alleging that since 2016, the company has used unfair tactics to obstruct consumers from disputing transactions through the credit card chargeback process, interfering with their legitimate refund rights.
